start_frame: Low from the hall floor at kneeling height: her kneeling body filling the right of frame, the tiny horseshoe-arched door filling the left, her hands turning the golden key in the tiny lock.
end_frame: The same frame as the lock turns and she pushes the fifteen-inch leaf open — her 1.35 m against its 0.38 m in one frame, and the first green light touching the flagstones as the leaf swings in.
constraint_honoured: 'The 0.38 m door is measured against her 1.35 m the moment it opens' — both gauges stay inside one still frame, deep focus, no reframe.
movement_note: A move would take one of the two gauges out of frame at the exact moment the comparison has to be made.
